name: 0 days without (Lenny, Simpsons)
meaning: A Simpsons character wearily resets a workplace safety sign back to "0 DAYS WITHOUT". For a streak broken yet again, or a mistake that keeps happening no matter what.
when_to_use: top = the thing that just happened again; it sits on the sign right after "DAYS WITHOUT", so it reads as one line (e.g. "an accident"). bottom = optional, a short note on who or what reset it (lower left).
baked_in_text: The sign already reads "DAYS WITHOUT" and both counter cards already show "0". The top caption only names the thing; do not restate the zero.
